facts.statement: Yunmenglong fossils were found in the Haoling Formation within the Ruyang Basin.
facts.quote: Its remains were discovered in the Haoling Formation of the Ruyang Basin.

facts.statement: The genus Yunmenglong was described in 2013 by Junchang Lü and colleagues.
facts.quote: described in 2013 by Junchang Lü et al.

facts.statement: Yunmenglong lived during the mid-Cretaceous, approximately between 125 and 100 million years ago, spanning the Aptian and Albian stages.
facts.quote: vivió a mediados del período Cretácico, hace aproximadamente entre 125 y 100 millones de años durante el Aptiense y el Albiense

facts.statement: Yunmenglong lived in what is now Asia.
facts.quote: en lo que es hoy Asia

facts.statement: Fossils of Yunmenglong were found in Henan Province, central China.
facts.quote: Susn fósiles se hallaron en la provincia de Henan, en el centro de lo que ahora es China.

facts.statement: The type specimen for Yunmenglong is the incomplete postcranial skeleton cataloged as 41HIII-0006, which lacks a skull.
facts.quote: basándose el holotipo, 41HIII-0006, un esqueleto parcial sin cráneo

facts.statement: The fossil remains include a significant portion of the vertebral column, comprising nine cervical vertebrae, one dorsal vertebra, and four tail vertebrae.
facts.quote: los restos incluyen una porción significativa de la columna vertebral: nueve vértebras cervicales - siete articuladas contando desde el axis -, una dorsal y cuatro vértebras de la cola

facts.statement: Yunmenglong is the first long-necked sauropod recorded from central China to date.
facts.quote: Yunmenglong representa el primer saurópodo de cuello largo registrado del centro de China hasta la fecha.

facts.statement: Yunmenglong is known from a complete right femur measuring about 1.92 meters in length and 65 centimeters in distal width.
facts.quote: complete right femur at about 1.92 m long and 65 cm in distal width

facts.statement: In 2016, Paul estimated Yunmenglong's length at 20 meters and its weight at 30 tonnes.
facts.quote: In 2016, Paul estimated it at 20 m in length and 30 t in weight.

facts.statement: In 2020, Molina-Pérez and Larramendi estimated a larger length of 27 meters for Yunmenglong, with a similar weight of 29 tonnes.
facts.quote: In 2020, Molina-Pérez and Larramendi gave a larger length of 27 m and a similar weight of 29 t.

facts.statement: Yunmenglong is classified within the unranked family Somphospondyli.
The parent group for Yunmenglong is Somphospondyli.
Yunmenglong lived from the Aptian to the Albian stages, between 121.4 and 100.5 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Albian (121.4 to 100.5 million years ago)

rejected.statement: Phylogenetic analysis places Yunmenglong as a sister taxon to Qiaowanlong, a group that is more derived than Euhelopus but basal to Titanosauria.
rejected.quote: a phylogenetic analysis places it as a sister taxon of Qiaowanlong, both grouped with Erketu in a position more derived than Euhelopus but basal to Titanosauria.
rejected.reason: statement copies the source wording: 'more derived than Euhelopus but basal to Titanosauria'
